name: MAD CAT Design® Tools
author: MAD CAT Design®

sections.description:
MAD CAT Design® Tools provides a central admin dashboard for compatible MAD CAT Design® WordPress modules and lightweight site tools.

MAD CAT Design® Tools is developed by Vladislav Moroz, the web designer and developer behind MAD CAT Design®.

The plugin includes a shared dashboard, module registry, compatibility checks, system status information and common settings for compatible extensions.

It helps keep related site tools organized in one clear interface instead of spreading settings across multiple unrelated admin pages.

Compatible MAD CAT Design® extensions are installed as separate plugins and can register themselves in the MCD Tools dashboard.

Features

  • Central dashboard for compatible MAD CAT Design® modules
  • Module registry for compatible extensions
  • Compatibility checks
  • System status information
  • Common settings area for supported tools
  • Shared admin structure for lightweight WordPress site tools

Support: support@madcatdesign.de
Website: https://madcatdesign.de
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/mcd-tools directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the MCD Tools dashboard in the WordPress admin area.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin include all MAD CAT Design® extensions?

No. MCD Tools provides the central dashboard and module registry. Compatible extensions are installed as separate plugins.

Can I use MCD Tools without additional extensions?

Yes. MCD Tools provides the central dashboard, module overview, compatibility checks and system status information. Additional compatible extensions can extend the available functionality.

Do compatible extensions require MCD Tools?

Some compatible MAD CAT Design® extensions use MCD Tools as their shared dashboard and management layer.
